# `hk util python-debug-statements`

- **Usage:** `hk util python-debug-statements <FILES>…`
- **Effect:** read-only

Detect Python debug statements

## Arguments

- **`<FILES>…`** — Files to check

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help

<!-- hk documentation examples -->

## Examples

Check Python files for debugging statements.

```sh
hk util python-debug-statements app.py
```
